newsitem.title: UK: Midland Independent News hit by exceptionals.
newsitem.headline: Midland Independent News hit by exceptionals.

text.p: NOTE - Midland Independent News Plc said that by active management in acquisition and closure it had refocussed its free weekly newspaper operations on its strongest markets and was now in a position to improve both the profitability and the operating margins of its newspapers.

* The group said results were shown before exceptional items relating to an abortive acquisition (1.4 million stg), closure costs (0.6 million stg) and a resulting balance sheet write off off of 2.6 million stg.
After taking into account exceptional items, the pre-tax profit on ordinary activities was 3.7 million stg compared to 9.4 million stg and earnings per share were 1.17 pence.
